The "fix" for this audit tick is the canonical, gotcha-aware tick procedure. It cannot be *executed* in this sandbox because the target environment is entirely absent (see EVIDENCE), so the deliverable below is the exact procedure that should run in the real cron session — with all five documented gotchas encoded:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# go-audit-neverdone-clean-gates — 14-point NEVER-DONE audit tick
set -euo pipefail
REPO="$HOME/repo"                       # target Go repo root
GO=golangci-lint; [ -x /home/kara/go/bin/golangci-lint ] && GO=/home/kara/go/bin/golangci-lint   # gotcha: not on PATH in cron
HILO=/home/kara/.cargo/bin/hilo         # gotcha: absolute path
BOARD_PY=~/.hermes/venvs/board/bin/python3  # gotcha: JSONL board venv, NOT parquet script
cd "$REPO"

# --- code gates (must be zero delta; nothing here touches code) ---
go build ./...                                   # 1 build
go vet ./...                                     # 2 vet
test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"                          # 3 gofmt clean
go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum # 4 mod-check
go test -count=1 -short -timeout 600s ./...      # 5 full short suite

# --- static analysis / freshness gates ---
DUMP=$(mktemp --suffix=.json)
$GO run --out-format json --uniq-by-line=false \
     --max-issues-per-linter=0 --max-same-issues=0 ./... > "$DUMP"  # 6 goconst strict JSON
# gotcha: count script REQUIRES the dump path arg; bare run only prints usage
python3 scripts/count_goconst_by_package.py "$DUMP"                 # 7 package breakdown
go run ./scripts/generate-openapi --generate-missing                 # 8 regen openapi
git diff --exit-code                                                 # 9 freshness gate
gitreins guard --full-suite          # 10 no Go files staged -> full-suite fallback = honest signal
"$HILO" stats --fresh                 # 11 hilo stats (gotcha: absolute path)

# --- board (JSONL-NORM-001: append_board_event.py + update_board_task_notes.py only) ---
"$BOARD_PY" append_board_event.py --type audit-tick --tick-idle 0      # 12 board event
"$BOARD_PY" update_board_task_notes.py \
    --last-commit a9391b87 --ticks-idle 0        # 13 gotcha: keep last_commit = last CODE commit
git add board.jsonl && git commit -m "board: audit tick" && git push   # 14 board commit only; zero code delta
```

Key corrections baked in: absolute paths for `golangci-lint`/`hilo`; `count_goconst_by_package.py "$DUMP"` (never bare); JSONL board tooling via the hermes venv (never the parquet script); `ticks_idle=0`; `last_commit` pinned to the last code commit `a9391b87`, not the board commit.
